about: The Workbench icons of the Nanosaur drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/nanosaur.png) is upstream's packaging/Nanosaur.png (512 x 512) scaled to 128 x 128, under the game's own terms. Nanosaur-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Nanosaur.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Nanosaur.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, Licence.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the Data and User drawers' icon.
